test_item:
KeyInstall feature should prevent installation any non-platform specific keys.
(R1LRefresh keys are used for the installation attempt)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. A USB drive containing non-platform raw keys has been inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file>
er: 1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file> output shows the installstate value 3
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-003 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: key platform scope; rule 1 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
